title: wg: room-policy-04 child rooms cannot be listed, created or joined
description: No mechanism lists a parent's child rooms, canCreateSubgroup is only reserved (§8.7), and nothing lets parent participants join a child room (preauth uses credential claims only). Fix: define listing, creation capability and a parent-member join rule. Found by the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18.
